outputs.explanation: Panel A is a western blot image, not a plot showing averages.
Panel B is phase contrast micrographs, not a plot.
The bar chart in panel C (bottom) shows individual data points (circles, squares, triangles) overlaid on the bars representing mean ± SEM.
The bar chart in panel D (bottom) shows individual data points overlaid on the bars representing mean ± SD.
Panel E consists of heatmaps, which are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel F is a western blot image, not a plot showing averages.
Both bar charts in panel G show individual data points (symbols) overlaid on the bars representing mean ± SEM.
Panel H shows immunofluorescence micrographs, not a plot.
